item.title: Villanova Men’s Basketball Secures Victory Over Butler, 82-73
item.description: On Wednesday, Feb. 25, Villanova men’s basketball secured its twenty-second victory of the season, defeating Butler University, 82-73. ​The win makes head coach Kevin Willard the winningest coach at Villanova (22-6, 13-4 Big East) in their first year with the program. item.title: Women’s Basketball Dominates Seton Hall, 82-52, In Regular Season Finale
item.description: On Thursday, Feb. 26, sophomore guard Jasmine Bascoe scored 28 points to help Villanova women’s basketball to an 82-52 win over Seton Hall, in its final game of the regular season. Bascoe also totaled 8 steals and 7 assists. This was Villanova’s (23-6, 16-4 Big East) second win over Seton Hall (18-10, 12-7 Big East) ...

item.title: Villanova Forward Matt Hodge Set To Miss Remainder Of Season With ACL Tear
item.description: Villanova redshirt freshman forward Matt Hodge will miss the rest of the 2025-26 season with an ACL tear that will require surgery, the program announced on Monday, March 2. item.description: On Saturday, March 7, Villanova men’s basketball defeated Xavier, 91-78, at the Finneran Pavilion with the help of senior forward Duke Brennan’s 20-point, 13-rebound double-double in the regular season finale.
